messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-01-06] standup/atlas/2025-01-06: Team Atlas this year is Priya and Tomasz Nowak.
- [2025-02-21] standup/boreal/2025-02-21: The bus deploy window: on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.
- [2025-11-21] standup/dune/2025-11-21: Heads-up from team Dune: billing-api's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send.
- [2025-06-05] standup/boreal/2025-06-05: On-call rotation: Marcus Oyelaran is primary for team Boreal starting today; Lena is off rotation.
- [2025-06-23] standup/atlas/2025-06-23: The quarterly capacity review is run by Priya.
- [2025-06-20] handover/2025-06-20-webhooks: Webhooks has a new home: Ember. Atlas kept it until today.
- [2026-06-18] standup/ember/2026-06-18: Team Ember on-call swapped this morning. Diego carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-02-21] standup/cinder/2025-02-21: Rotation day for team Cinder: Yuki Tanaka hands the pager to Diego Alvarez. Team Cinder saw that the auth gateway's cold start time tripled following the runtime upgrade; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-04-07] standup/atlas/2025-04-07: Team Atlas on-call swapped this morning. Priya carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2026-05-25] standup/atlas/2026-05-25: Marcus picked up the Atlas on-call shift from Priya today.
- [2026-03-09] standup/atlas/2026-03-09: On-call rotation: Marcus Oyelaran is primary for team Atlas starting today; Priya is off rotation.
- [2025-11-06] standup/dune/2025-11-06-2: Dune planning meeting is every Wednesday.
- [2025-06-19] handover/2025-06-19-notifier: Notifier has a new home: team Dune. Cinder kept it until today.
- [2025-06-13] standup/ember/2025-06-13-2: Team Ember planning meeting is every Friday.
- [2025-06-27] standup/boreal/2025-06-27-2: Boreal adopted a weekly dependency update day.
- [2025-06-05] standup/boreal/2025-06-05-2: Lena Fischer is the release captain for Q1 2026.
- [2025-06-27] standup/boreal/2025-06-27: Boreal saw that the bus' request volume halved following the client rollout; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-06-16] handover/2025-06-16-catalog: Boreal is taking over the catalog from team Dune, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2026-06-16] standup/ember/2026-06-16: The weekly architecture review is run by Oskar.
- [2025-11-06] standup/dune/2025-11-06: Heads-up from the Dune team: search-indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send.
- [2025-06-23] standup/cinder/2025-06-23: Observation from the Cinder team: after the retention change, the reports pipeline's disk usage jumped 30 percent.
- [2025-06-13] standup/ember/2025-06-13: Decision: the scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node, because the fixed node turned every restart into a missed run.
- [2026-06-08] standup/dune/2026-06-08: Rotation day for Dune: Tomasz hands the pager to Farah.
- [2025-06-12] standup/dune/2025-06-12: The Dune team noticed that the notifier's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners. Dune sits on the fourth floor.
- [2025-07-17] standup/dune/2025-07-17: Reminder: Farah is on call for Dune this cycle.
- [2025-01-08] standup/atlas/2025-01-08: The ledger lives with Atlas. The billing service lives with team Atlas.
- [2025-01-16] standup/dune/2025-01-16: First on-call rotation for team Dune goes to Farah Haddad.
- [2025-01-13] standup/boreal/2025-01-13: Lena takes the first Boreal on-call shift of the year.
- [2025-01-14] standup/atlas/2025-01-14: Atlas pager: Priya has it first.
- [2025-01-14] standup/ember/2025-01-14: Oskar Lind is on call for the Ember team to start the year.
- [2025-01-14] standup/cinder/2025-01-14: Yuki takes the first team Cinder on-call shift of the year.
- [2025-10-31] standup/atlas/2025-10-31: Team Atlas runs its planning on Tuesdays.
- [2025-03-10] standup/atlas/2025-03-10-2: The Atlas team sits on the second floor.
- [2025-01-08] standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2: Feature-flags lives with Atlas.
- [2025-07-02] standup/atlas/2025-07-02: Tomasz has transferred to Dune. Team Atlas continues without them.
- [2025-05-09] standup/atlas/2025-05-09: Reminder from Atlas: page Tomasz for anything this cycle, not Priya.
- [2025-09-08] standup/boreal/2025-09-08: The Boreal team on-call swapped this morning. Marcus carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-07-10] standup/cinder/2025-07-10: Team Cinder on-call swapped this morning. Yuki carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-07-03] standup/atlas/2025-07-03: Reminder from Atlas: page Priya for anything this cycle, not Tomasz Nowak.
